prompt:
Look at the shape-assembly puzzle in the image: an outline-style shape-assembly puzzle with several piece silhouettes above labeled target-shape options. Determine which labeled silhouette can be built from the pieces when every piece must be used exactly once and pieces may be rotated but not flipped. Respond with the option letter of the shape that can be built.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence format: set "evidence" to an array containing exactly one bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2] for the correct option panel.
Answer requirement: set "answer" to the exact option letter of the correct image option.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[222,488,398,692]],"answer":"C"}
